name: Roman
summary: NASA wide-field near-infrared space observatory whose dark-matter studies include weak lensing, Galactic structure and primordial-black-hole microlensing.
detection_principle: Wide-area near-infrared imaging measures galaxy shapes and time-domain stellar photometry to test dark-matter distributions and compact dark objects.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
